$comment: Pinned snapshot of the verified bundled service plugins in Anthropic's public claude-plugins-official catalog. Derived 2026-09-11 by resolving the marketplace at the pinned catalog commit to each provider repository/commit (read-only HTTP, no plugin code executed, no auth). Claude auto-discovers a root .mcp.json; manifest-wired non-default paths were also inspected. This file is an import input, not the shipped catalog; provider configs are preserved verbatim (including Claude-specific OAuth client references, which the importer strips) so imports stay reproducible without network access.
scope: Plugins whose bundled config is a direct remote service MCP (86) or a stdio SaaS adapter (32). Excluded upstream categories: no_declared_mcp (138), local_utility_or_self_hosted_db (19), conditional_service_adapter (6), hosted_docs_only (8), hosted_search_data_or_public_pricing (5), unresolved_service_scope (1).

plugins.name: airwallex-dev
plugins.notes: Developer endpoint supports current docs AND sandbox API calls (pinned README); not docs-only.

catalyst-by-zoho._note: This is the US data center endpoint. If your Catalyst account is on a different DC (EU, IN, AU, JP, SA, CA, UAE), ask the AI assistant to help you switch — it will guide you to the correct endpoint for your region.

plugins.name: cloudinary
plugins.notes: Five distinct endpoints but one plugin/provider. Declares streamable-http vocabulary; Prime compatibility not tested.

cockroachdb-toolbox-http._comment: SSE transport — run 'toolbox --config tools.yaml' first, then connect via this URL

plugins.name: datadog
plugins.notes: DD_MCP_DOMAIN is configurable; default not-setup is not a live service URL. Datadog API/app-key fields confirm target service; no auth/run test.

plugins.name: deploy-on-aws
plugins.notes: HTTP awsknowledge is docs-only. Service inclusion is the stdio AWS IaC server, which reads CloudFormation/CloudTrail using AWS credentials; not a direct remote service MCP.

plugins.name: dominodatalab
plugins.notes: API key/host wired to vendored Domino MCP; command directory is an absolute workspace path and may require adjustment. Declaration, not runnability verified.

plugins.name: gitkraken
plugins.notes: Local gk MCP wraps GitKraken APIs and git-host/issue providers (GitHub/Jira); local git capabilities alone do not justify inclusion.

legalzoom.description: LegalZoom MCP server for attorney consultations and legal services

netlify.note: Official Netlify MCP server (hosted, streamable HTTP). Authorizes via OAuth on first connection — the agent is prompted to sign in to Netlify; no token or local install required. Lets the agent create and manage Netlify projects, deploys, and environment variables.

plugins.name: rc
plugins.notes: Same RevenueCat endpoint as revenuecat. Counted as separate plugin, one provider.

RevenueCat.description: RevenueCat MCP server for project configuration and data access
RevenueCat MCP server for project configuration and data access

plugins.name: semgrep
plugins.notes: Pinned hook dispatcher starts Guardian MCP; pinned repository README documents login and pulling projects/findings from Semgrep app.

plugins.name: terraform
plugins.notes: Pinned Docker server 0.4.0 supports HCP Terraform workspaces/private registry with TFE_TOKEN, not just public Terraform docs.

plugins.name: vanta-mcp-plugin
plugins.notes: Same three regional Vanta endpoints as vanta. Counted as separate plugin, one provider.

vercel.note: Official Vercel MCP server. Uses OAuth — on first connection the agent will be prompted to authorize via Vercel. Read-only in initial release: search docs, list projects/deployments, inspect logs.

plugins.name: windsor-ai
plugins.notes: Declares type:url rather than standard Claude type:http; endpoint is evidence of intent, not schema/runtime compatibility.

windsor-ai.description: Windsor.ai marketing data — query ad spend, campaigns, and analytics from 50+ sources
